checks.title: Manage secrets
checks.description: Viewing secrets at the cluster-scope is akin to cluster-admin in most clusters as there are typically at least one service accounts (their token stored in a secret) bound to cluster-admin directly or a role/clusterrole that gives similar permissions.
checks.remediation: Manage secrets are not allowed. Remove resource 'secrets' from cluster role

checks.title: Manage configmaps
checks.description: Some workloads leverage configmaps to store sensitive data or configuration parameters that affect runtime behavior.
checks.remediation: Remove write permission verbs for resource 'configmaps'

checks.title: Manage all resources
checks.description: Full control of the cluster resources, and therefore also root on all nodes where workloads can run and has access to all pods, secrets, and data.
messages: ClusterRole permits wildcard verb on wildcard resource
checks.remediation: Remove '*' from 'rules.resources'. Provide specific list of resources to be managed by cluster role
